Arjun Bose
arjun.bose@example.com | +91 99817 67925 | GitHub | LinkedIn | Portfolio
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven software engineer with strong foundation in distributed systems, high-concurrency backend services, and clean architecture. Experienced in designing fault-tolerant microservices, optimizing database throughput, and shipping production code with rigorous test coverage.

Cumulative Grade Point Average: 8.40/10.0
WORK EXPERIENCE
Full Stack Software Engineer — CRED (Dreamplug Technologies), Bengaluru, India  Jun 2023 - Present
• Migrated monolithic checkout service to gRPC microservices, shrinking cloud compute costs by 32% and reducing deployment cycle times from 4 hours to 12 minutes.
• Architected high-throughput payment webhook processor using Go and Redis Streams, handling 14,000 requests/sec with p99 latency under 28ms.
